summary: Describes the Extensible Provisioning Protocol, an XML-based client-server protocol for managing objects stored in a shared central repository, such as domain names at a registry. It defines generic operations and an extension framework for mapping them to object types. It was replaced by RFC 4930.

eli5.summary: Domain registries need a common way for companies to ask them to add, change or delete names. EPP is that common language, written in a structured text format.

questions: how do registrars talk to registries
